verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
By the Dawn,
And the Ten Nights,
And the Even and the Odd,
And the Night when it moves on to its end,

verses.ar: ہَلۡ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِیۡ حِجۡرٍ ؕ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: Is there not in it a strong evidence for a man of understanding?

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ کَیۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّکَ بِعَادٍ ۪ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with ‘Ad —
The tribe of Iram, possessors of lofty buildings,

verses.ar: الَّتِیۡ لَمۡ یُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُہَا فِی الۡبِلَادِ ۪ۙ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]The like of whom have not been created in these parts —
And with Thamud who hewed out rocks in the valley,
And with Pharaoh, lord of vast camps?
[✲]Who transgressed in the cities,
And wrought much corruption therein.
Thy Lord then let fall on them the whip of punishment.
Surely thy Lord is on the watch

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا الۡاِنۡسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰٮہُ رَبُّہٗ فَاَکۡرَمَہٗ وَنَعَّمَہٗ ۬ۙ فَیَقُوۡلُ رَبِّیۡۤ اَکۡرَمَنِ ﴿ؕ۱۶﴾
verses.en: As for man, when his Lord tries him and honours him and bestows favours on him, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me.’

verses.ar: وَاَمَّاۤ اِذَا مَا ابۡتَلٰٮہُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَیۡہِ رِزۡقَہٗ ۬ۙ فَیَقُوۡلُ رَبِّیۡۤ اَہَانَنِ ﴿ۚ۱۷﴾
verses.en: But when He tries him and straitens for him his means of subsistence, he says, ‘My Lord has disgraced me.’
Nay, but you honour not the orphan,
And you urge not one another to feed the poor,
And you devour the heritage of other people wholly,
And you love wealth with exceeding love.

verses.ar: کَلَّاۤ اِذَا دُکَّتِ الۡاَرۡضُ دَکًّا دَکًّا ﴿ۙ۲۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]Nay, when the earth is completely broken into pieces and made level;
And thy Lord comes and also the angels ranged in rows after rows;

verses.ar: وَجِایۡٓءَ یَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بِجَہَنَّمَ ۬ۙ یَوۡمَئِذٍ یَّتَذَکَّرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ وَاَنّٰی لَہُ الذِّکۡرٰی ﴿ؕ۲۴﴾
verses.en: And Hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but of what avail shall be his remembrance?
He will say, ‘O would that I had sent on some good works for my life here!’
So on that day none can punish like unto His punishment,
And none can bind like unto His binding;
And thou, O soul at peace!
Return to thy Lord well pleased with Him and He well pleased with thee.
So enter thou among My chosen servants,
And enter thou My Garden.
